avis.titre: Adore this product - helped a bad breakout!
avis.texte: Such a lightweight toner, it genuinely feels like you're tapping water into your skin. I LOVE it! It's so easy to apply, doesn't feel heavy or greasy, and actually is so soothing for my skin. I was having irritation from some product I had tested and I randomly got a bunchhh of acne from that product, so I decided to quit everything I was using and take a chance on this item from the Knemo line and a Knemo essence and I kid you not - the acne is GONE! 0 irritation, healed my skin wonderfully. Also there's no scent to it, sensitive skin friendly for sure. Will continue purchasing this 💗

this toner is so good. it actually gets rid of the texture on my chin and forehead and makes me feel less oily throughout the day. i love that its super gentle so i can use it every day as well. im almost done with my first bottle and will buy again

avis.titre: my favorite toner of all time!
avis.texte: i have tried so many toners and this one is one of the best i've ever tried. it's super cooling and helped with my skin texture

I have acne-prone and sensitive skin, and I can actually see an improvement in my skin texture and smaller pores after using this product! Love the lightweight texture, and when I layer it, it feels like it really helps with inner dryness.

avis.titre: Smooth skin, flawless makeup the next day!
avis.texte: This toner has been a game-changer for my routine. After using it at night, I wake up with smoother, calmer skin, and my makeup applies so much better the next day. No patchiness, no excess shine—just a fresh, even base that makes foundation glide on effortlessly. It's like prepping my skin overnight!
I've been using this toner every day, and it's amazing for minimizing pores!

My skin always feels smoother and less red right after I use it. I have combo skin that breaks out easily, and this helps keep my pores and oil in check without drying me out. It's fragrance-free too, which I love.
